name: Bethel Shopping Center
summary: Bethel Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination on Stony Hill Road in Bethel, CT, offering convenient access to everyday shopping and services. With a 4.6-star rating and consistent daily hours, it serves as a reliable community shopping option for Fairfield County residents.
demographics: Bethel Shopping Center serves a predominantly suburban family demographic in Fairfield County, Connecticut, one of the wealthiest counties in the United States. The primary trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income households with median household incomes exceeding $100,000, consisting largely of families with children and working professionals aged 35-65. The center draws from Bethel and surrounding communities including Danbury, Newtown, and Redding, with shoppers seeking convenient neighborhood retail for everyday needs and services. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for quick, accessible trips for groceries, personal services, and routine purchases rather than destination shopping experiences.
description: Bethel Shopping Center is a neighborhood shopping destination conveniently located on Stony Hill Road in Bethel, Connecticut, serving the local community and surrounding Fairfield County area. This well-established retail center provides residents with easy access to essential services and everyday shopping needs in a convenient strip center format. With a strong 4.6-star rating from nearly 80 reviews, the center has built a reputation for reliable service and accessibility within the community. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Bethel Shopping Center offers consistent hours that accommodate both working professionals and families throughout the week. The center's location in affluent Fairfield County positions it as a practical shopping option for the area's suburban residents seeking quality retailers and services close to home.
